# Vibration test

A minimal original WIPI-C clet for `1.2.1/lgt-raptor/aram-wie-raptor` that exercises vibration, media mute state, and backlight control. A host gamepad rumble motor or phone vibrator can be verified end to end. It draws only code-drawn rectangles and text and contains no commercial assets.
